items.title: OSI Hackathon 2026: Sydney at UNSW
items.org: Hubert (Sydney site of the global Open Scientific Intelligence Hackathon)
items.notes: Wed 21 Oct and Thu 22 Oct, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm each day, venue closed overnight. Tools for scientific discovery: LLM apps and agents, research software, datasets and knowledge graphs. Anyone can register; every on-site person must register individually on the organiser's Luma page (UNSW policy). Team rules not stated. No registration deadline published; using start date. Official Luma link not shown on the listing and the /go/ redirect is robots-blocked, so the link is the Hackathons Australia page. On campus, about 10 min walk from UNSW Village (⚠️ estimate). ⚠️ Clash: Week 6, when the COMP9020 Foundations of Computer Science mid-term test (26%) runs; check the test day.

items.title: HarbourHack
items.prize: major prize pool, amount not stated
items.notes: Kickoff mixer Fri 23 Oct, build weekend Sat 24 to Sun 25 Oct, ship and submissions Mon 26 to Wed 28 Oct, finals Fri 30 Oct. For student and early-career builders; applications open, host approval needed. Solo builders accepted; teams up to 5 (3 to 4 recommended), every member registers. Three tracks to be released the week before launch. Year not printed beside the dates; organiser tagline says 'First stop: Sydney, 2026'. No registration deadline published; using start date. ⚠️ Clash: Mon 26 Oct has COMP9021 Principles of Programming Assignment 1 (due 11:59 am) and the COMP9024 Data Structures and Algorithms Week 6 Moodle quiz (due 4:00 pm).

items.title: AI On Apple - Sydney Hackathon (Sydney Apple AI Hackathon)
items.cost: $50 per Hackathons Australia; Luma shows no price and charges only approved applicants (non-refundable)
items.prize: Grand, enterprise, visionOS, social impact, beginner and People's Choice prizes; amounts TBA
items.notes: Fri 23 Oct, 6:30 pm pre-event; Sat 24 Oct, 10:00 am to 8:00 pm; Sun 25 Oct, 10:00 am to 2:00 pm, then judging. Application-based; you apply alone and form a team over the weekend. On-device LLM and vision apps, agents, multimodal and spatial computing for Apple platforms. Independent event, not endorsed by Apple. No registration deadline published; using start date. Also listed on Hackeroos (de-duplicated). About 35 to 45 min by light rail or bus from UNSW Village (⚠️ estimate). ⚠️ Clash: weekend before Mon 26 Oct deadlines (COMP9021 Principles of Programming Assignment 1, COMP9024 Data Structures and Algorithms Week 6 quiz).

items.title: MAUI Hack Day - Sydney
items.city: Sydney (SSW, 81 to 91 Military Road, Level 1, NSW 2089)
items.notes: Sat 13 Feb, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. .NET MAUI mobile development; beginners welcome; bring a laptop with .NET MAUI tooling. Learning-day style rather than a prize competition. SSW may cancel if enrolment is low. No registration deadline published; using start date. Summer break. About 60 min by public transport from UNSW Village (⚠️ estimate). Also listed on Hackeroos.

items.title: UNIHACK 2027
items.city: Sydney hub not yet confirmed (AU/NZ hybrid)
items.prize: Main Prize plus sponsor challenge prizes; amounts not listed
items.notes: Fri 12 Mar to Sun 14 Mar, 48-hour hybrid hackathon, 1000+ students expected. No official theme; any project. Eligibility: 18+ and a university or TAFE student in Australia or New Zealand. Teams of 4 to 6 (smaller teams asked to merge), so not solo-friendly. Pre-registration open via the form linked on the site. 2027 hubs not listed yet; 2026 had a Sydney hub (⚠️ unconfirmed for 2027). No registration deadline published; using start date. Falls in UNSW Term 1 2027 (⚠️ check term dates).

items.title: AI Hack Day - Sydney
items.city: Sydney (SSW, 81 to 91 Military Road, Level 1, NSW 2089)
items.notes: Sat 10 Jul, 9:00 am to 2:00 pm (AEST, so +10:00). Learn and build with Microsoft AI and ML tools; all levels welcome. Workshop-style day, no prizes listed. No registration deadline published; using start date. About 60 min by public transport from UNSW Village (⚠️ estimate). Also listed on Hackeroos.

items.title: Cyber in Motion Battle of the Uni-Verse Student Capture the Flag Challenge Competition
items.prize: Awards for most liked, top creators, top competitors, grand champion; no cash listed. Top 4 teams go to a final on 28 Nov
items.notes: Sat 24 Oct, 10:00 am to 2:00 pm AEST. Teams of 5 to 10 students (16+, school or tertiary) first write their own CTF challenges, then solve other teams' challenges. Deadline shown is the end of the challenge-creation phase, Tue 20 Oct, 5:00 pm AEST; no separate registration deadline published. Needs a full team and a Brisbane trip, so low feasibility. Also listed on Hackeroos.

items.title: CareerPathHack
items.notes: Wed 4 Nov, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. Make jobs, skills and career-pathway data easier for Australians to use. 18+, no coding needed; register solo (matched to a group) or as a team. Places limited. No registration deadline published; using start date. Also listed on Hackeroos. ⚠️ Clash: Week 8 weekday plus Canberra travel; COMP9021 Principles of Programming weekly quiz is due Wednesdays 11:59 am.

items.title: Tanda AI Hackathon: What if...?
items.notes: Fri 20 Nov from 5:30 pm AEST to Sat 21 Nov, 5:30 pm AEST. Open 'What if...?' theme (games, fixes for small annoyances, experiments). Teams form on day 1, so you can come alone. Claude Code and Anthropic API access provided; not affiliated with Anthropic. No registration deadline published; using start date. Organiser page reached only via a robots-blocked /go/ link. ⚠️ Clash: Week 10; Mon 23 Nov has COMP9021 Principles of Programming Assignment 2 (11:59 am) and the COMP9024 Data Structures and Algorithms Week 10 quiz (4:00 pm).

items.title: ANZDATA 50th Anniversary Datathon
items.cost: $100 to $200 regular, $50 to $100 early bird until 15 Nov 2026 (by role)
items.notes: Wed 17 Feb, 9:00 am to 4:00 pm ACDT. Real clinical question on de-identified kidney registry data, NDA required. Students, data scientists and statisticians welcome; organisers build mixed teams. Early-bird pricing ends Sun 15 Nov 2026; no registration deadline published; using start date. Summer break. Also listed on Hackeroos.

items.title: AI Hack Day - Melbourne
items.notes: Sat 20 Feb, 9:00 am to 3:00 pm. Same SSW learning-day format as the Sydney AI Hack Day; all levels welcome. No registration deadline published; using start date. Summer break. Also listed on Hackeroos.
